title: Retrofitted LLM can count the letter ‘i’s in ‘artificial intelligence’
title_zh: 改装后的LLM能够统计‘artificial intelligence’中‘i’字母的数量
abstract: Most LLMs cannot reliably evaluate text on the level of individual letters. A technique called byteification retrofits existing models to enable it.
abstract_zh: 大多数LLM无法可靠地在单个字母层面评估文本。一种称为字节化（byteification）的技术可以改装现有模型以实现此功能。
snippet: Most LLMs cannot reliably evaluate text on the level of individual letters. A technique called byteification retrofits existing models to enable it.
